subject: Fix aarch64 RDB compatibility integration tests (#1343)
reason: The change only fixes the project's own integration-test harness and build scripts: it adds an aarch64 prebuilt 1.0.0 module fixture to a test zip and makes the Python RDB-compatibility test pick the fixture per architecture, moves AI-assistant skill docs, and corrects an inverted sanitizer-build condition in submodules/package-submodules.sh that decides when Google Benchmark is compiled. No module source code changes, so the valkey-search module's runtime behavior (commands, replies, RDB format, replication) is identical on both builds; there is nothing a scenario could reach or mark expect_d
